source.prompt: Top-down seamless light maple hardwood surface for an early-2000s low-polygon basketball video game. One continuous court wood surface with long straight grain running vertically from top to bottom, warm honey and amber bands, restrained pores, broad readable tonal variation, gently baked-looking light. Limited-detail, slightly stylized PS2-era material. No plank joints, floorboards, court lines, logos, text, objects, shadows, perspective, glare, or photographic reflections.
optimizationSteps: Downloaded 512 x 512 PNG source to an ignored local staging directory.
Encoded the accepted source to WebP at quality 76 with effort 6; no resize or color alteration.

validation.notes: The downloaded image and a 2x2 tile proof were inspected. The optimized file loaded in local Vite and the wood reads under current arena lighting at desktop and touch sizes. Desktop movement, shot and reset and touch joystick, camera drag, shot and reset were exercised. No controls or collision data changed. Headless desktop pointer lock did not activate, so mouse-look still needs a headed check.

integration.fallback: The existing colored procedural plank materials remain visible while loading and if the WebP fails to load.
